name: io.github.iPAYX-Technologies/mcp-fx-audit
title: iPayX FX Audit
description: Forensic FX audit MCP. Live mid-market rates, spread scoring and hidden bank fee detection.

tools.name: check_fx_mid_market_rate
tools.description: Returns the live mid-market FX rate for a currency pair (Twelve Data, Open Exchange Rates fallback), in both directions (pair and inverted_pair). Inputs: currency_from, currency_to, optional bank_rate. When bank_rate is given, the output also includes the spread versus mid-market; both quote directions (rate and 1/rate) are tested, the closer one is kept and flagged as inverted when 1/rate wins; a rate more than 10% from mid-market in both directions is rejected as incoherent.

bank_rate.description: Optional bank/broker rate. When provided, returns spread vs mid-market and tests both quote directions; >10% off in both → rejected as incoherent.

tools.name: audit_fx_transaction
tools.description: Audits one currency transaction against the live mid-market rate. Inputs: amount, currency_from, currency_to, bank_rate. Output: FX score from 1 to 10, rating, color badge, verdict, currency pair, amount and date.

bank_rate.description: Rate the bank/broker actually charged (alias: taux)

language.description: Optional output language. Auto-detected from input keys (montant/taux → fr) when omitted.

tools.name: full_forensic_fx_report
tools.description: Produces a full FX audit report for one transaction (score, spread, estimated loss, breakdown and routing recommendation). Inputs: amount, currency_from, currency_to, bank_rate, optional company_name. Available without an API key within the shared allowance of 3 audits per IP per calendar month; valid Bearer API keys retain existing access.

company_name.description: Optional company name for the report

tools.name: compare_fx_sources
tools.description: Compares a bank rate with the live mid-market rate. Inputs: amount, currency_from, currency_to, bank_rate, optional bank_name. Output: each source's effective rate, markup in basis points, cost per 100,000, FX score, and the lowest-cost source.

bank_name.description: Name of the bank (e.g. BMO, RBC, Chase)
